t: What Medication Interaction Evidence Database Is All About
title: What Medication Interaction Evidence Database Is All About
description: Drug interactions change what a dose does: grapefruit juice blocks CYP3A4, raising statin levels; warfarin's effect swings with vitamin K foods and dozens of drugs (INR monitoring manages it); MAOIs plus SSRIs can trigger serotonin syndrome. Severity runs from trivial to fatal; evidence runs from case reports to controlled trials. Reference information only — medication changes need prescribers and pharmacists. This database is the complete drug interaction: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
